title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Cherry Berry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Berry combines juicy Cherry sweetness with a mix of ripe, tangy Berries for a smooth, fruity vape. The flavour strikes a balance between rich and bright, keeping each puff light and satisfying. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod connected to a 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No refilling or coil changes required—just connect to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Dual mesh coils maintain flavour quality and vapour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
